notes: Margins are B − A in points (Republican minus Democratic slot); probB is P(margin > 0).
The published margin is the simulation mean, not the median; the anchor matches the mean and P(B) jointly.
Calibration never moves mass between histogram bins: knots place the published mass below 0, p10 and p90 inside their bins, and one power warp inside the other bins sets the mean.
Geography: a uniform two-party log-odds shift of the county file's baseline, solved per draw; turnout and other votes are held at the file's values.
Draws are not stored; prior.ts regenerates them exactly from the histogram and calibration.

needs.HOUSE_DIST: est.dist for each district ({lo, w, c} like Senate/governor, or the draws) from the per-district `marg` array in scripts/forecast/model/house_dyn.py (note: that array is D − R; publish R − D).
needs.MEASURE_DIST: a Yes-share histogram from the `draws` in scripts/forecast/measures/build_measures.py, plus, for all-ballots and ballot-floor rules, the total-ballots draws the threshold is measured against.
needs.DOWNBALLOT_DIST: est.dist for each statewide down-ballot race from scripts/forecast/downballot/build_downballot.py; downballot.json publishes only margin, prob, p10 and p90.
needs.NO_FORECAST: a forecast; none is published for local, judicial or special races.
needs.CHAMBER: nothing at race level; chamber control is a Phase B aggregation.
needs.MODEL_ENTRY: a model.json entry for this race.
needs.FINER_DIST: the simulation draws, or a finer histogram, for this race.
